Sugar Grove – 129 Live Oak Street – Seagrove Beach, FL

Book with Stay 30A and receive up to $560 in Beach Gear delivered to your Vacation Home! $280 is provided for weekly stays.

Located in Old Seagrove, nestled among the live oaks and magnolias, Sugar Grove is a 4 bedroom, 2.5 bath beach cottage that sleeps ten and is ideal for your family getaway. It is the perfect place to relax and enjoy your vacation. Sugar Grove is located centrally on 30A, just a quick walk or bike ride to everything…beach, galleries, fine cuisine, bike trails, markets, antiques, golf, live theater, a family run book store, outdoor bazaars, and coffee shops! Nestled amongst the Old Seagrove oak canopy, Sugar Grove offers the serenity you are looking for on vacation, while being just steps from the activities and events offered on Seaside’s Town Center.

1st Level: Inviting screened porch entrance with seating is a relaxing place for your morning coffee. Light, coastal decor and wood floors throughout. The first level includes the fully equipped kitchen, dining table with seating for 8 and the living room with comfortable sectional sofa and oversized side chair. The living room also includes a a Frame TV and gas fireplace. The Queen bedroom is located on the first floor and includes a private bath within with walk-in shower. The laundry room with side by side washer/dryer and a powder room completes this level.

2ndLevel: This level includes the remaining 3 bedrooms. The Bunk room includes 4 twins, a sofa, dresser and large screen TV. King Bedroom 1, King bedroom 2. A full bath includes double vanity and large walk-in shower.

Outside: Gravel driveway with parking for 2 cars, private outdoor shower, private heated 8 x 12 pool with pavered decking (fees apply for pool heating and must be pre-arranged), Firepit and outdoor table with seating for 6.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Regarding pricing, a cleaning and processing fee, a $109 Vacation Rental Damage Plan Fee and tax will be added to ALL rates. Travel Insurance can be added at Guest's choosing as well as optional pool heating.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
